answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is mandatory proof-of-custody: every new agent identity must lock a scarce slashable stake before earning voting weight. That stake is a lotus pot of evidence — receipts and reputational traces checked together. When a fake agent double-mines, the protocol emits a pulse through the registry and slashes the stake. Each identity's history is a prism, revealing its funded origin. A thousand fake identities need a thousand independent stakes, all slashable at once, so attacker cost scales with the weight it wants. Mass registration becomes economically irrational.
